Clarity: (1) rank labels are duplicated — a row of eight '8's runs across the top of the board while the left margin also shows 8–1, and the top-left '8' is clipped by the frame; (2) the file label 'a' is repeated inside multiple a-file squares instead of appearing once per file; (3) a stray hairline rectangle spanning the top rank and h-file reads as a stuck selection/outline; (4) the turn card shows a black king glyph next to 'White to move'; (5) the Undo button's kbd chip says 'Z' while the footer legend says 'U'. Visual system & craft: the d1 white piece renders as a shattered/fragmented glyph and a small cross floats detached above e1, so the piece set is not production-grade; white pieces use a thin outline plus a heavy offset shadow that reads as stickers and loses contrast on light squares, while black pieces are flat silhouettes — two inconsistent rendering treatments; the side panel is vertically centered, leaving a large dead zone in the bottom-right and misaligning with the board's top edge; the footer hint text is low-contrast. Expressiveness: the dark-navy/gold/serif identity and board palette are cohesive and promising, but the broken glyphs and label bugs undermine the 'genuinely beautiful' goal, and the composition is unbalanced (large board left, narrow centered panel right). Real trade-offs: in-square corner labels vs margin labels (in-square keeps the frame tight and aligns exactly to squares; margin labels are cleaner but need more border space); outline vs solid white pieces (outline is crisp on dark squares but weak on light; solid cream with a fine dark rim is consistent on both); centered vs top-aligned panel (centered looks composed but wastes space; top-aligned with a flex-grow history fills the column).
history.suggestion: Prioritized plan that preserves all required content: 1) Fix the coordinate system first — remove the duplicated top '8' row and all in-square 'a' repeats; render ranks once per row and files once per column as low-contrast corner labels inside the board edge (rank top-left, file bottom-right, tinted toward the opposite square color for legibility), and un-clip the corner labels from the frame. 2) Delete the stray hairline rectangle; implement real square-level states (selected, last-move, legal-move dots) as inset rounded highlights so highlights can never bleed across the board. 3) Rebuild all 32 pieces as one inline SVG set: repair the shattered d1 bishop, attach the king's cross, give white pieces a solid cream fill with a 1px dark rim and a soft even shadow (no offset sticker look), keep black as solid near-black with a subtle top rim-light, and verify every square renders correctly. 4) Correct the turn icon to a white piece for 'White to move' and add a gold active accent bar to the moving player's card, mirrored for Black. 5) Turn move history into an actual table (Move | White | Black headers) with 'No moves yet' as a styled empty row, scrollable when long. 6) Rebalance the layout: top-align the side panel with the board, let the history card flex-grow, pin the controls card to the bottom of the column, and match card radii/shadows to the board frame to eliminate the dead zone. 7) Consistency and finish pass: unify the Undo shortcut to 'U' in both the button chip and footer legend, raise footer hint contrast, align timer-chip styling across both player cards, and add hover/focus states to squares and buttons. This fixes the clarity-breaking bugs first, then strengthens systematic craft while retaining the existing gold-on-navy identity.
